text: {"frames":["This floor of the Tower smells of wool and cold dust. In the night the threads slipped off their spools and knotted themselves into a heap by the stairs. A chest near the window holds {a} grey threads, and a basket by the door holds {b} white ones. Which sign must go between them so that the knot-keeper knows which pile is larger: greater than, less than, or equal?","You climb to a round room where a lantern swings slowly above a thread bridge. Someone has tangled the bridge in the dark, and two little bundles now hang from its ends. One bundle has {a} silver knots, and the other has {b} silver knots. Which sign goes between them so the bridge can be untied in the right order?","The stairs of this floor creak softly, and a row of keys hangs on a hook. Each key has been tied to a loop of wool that is now a mess. One set of keys has {a} loops and the other has {b} loops. Which sign must you place between these two numbers to show which set is bigger?","Beyond the little town of Misty Ford, the door of this floor is stuck shut with a knot of blue thread. You listen and hear the spools humming behind it. On one side waits a group of {a} spools, on the other a group of {b} spools. Which sign goes between them so the door knows which side to open first?","On this floor a small furry creature sits beside a chest that is full of loose threads. Two spools have rolled out, one with {a} red turns of thread and one with {b} red turns. The creature taps the floor and waits for you to decide. Which sign goes between the two spools to show how they compare?"]}
